items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 25 at 4:04AM AKDT until October 25 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:

fog.

* WHERE...Eastern Chichagof Island, near Hoonah

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT this morning.

distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 25 at 3:55AM AKDT until October 26 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 AM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Southwest winds will build steadily Sunday
morning, becoming strong and gusty by Sunday afternoon. Winds are
expected to be strongest along the coast, but gusts as high as 55
mph are expected to persist inland up to Bethel.
items.areas: Kuskokwim Delta Coast and Nunivak Island; Interior Kuskokwim Delta
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
